title: Storm Chaser
summary: Explore official tropical cyclone information through an interactive regional map and forecast timeline.
controls: Select a storm, pan or zoom the map, and step through published forecast times.
limitations: Independent viewer of official JMA information, not an official warning service or independent forecast. The public Pages edition updates periodically; collection may be stale, delayed or unavailable. Recent bulletins only, not complete basin coverage. Local Node/SQLite archival capabilities belong to the separate local-first edition.

approval.note: Owner-accepted local-first v1.0 baseline with a separately authorized public Pages edition.
